snippet.title: Gladiator - Domark - 1986 - Amstrad CPC - Shortplay
snippet.description: Gladiator is a fighting video game published by Domark Limited for the 48K ZX Spectrums in 1985. Ports for the Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64 and 128K ZX Spectrums were released in 1986.
